name: Alpaca Cleaned
selection_note: Frequently used cleaned variant of Alpaca.
schema_note: Instruction, optional input, and output are counted.

name: Databricks Dolly 15k
selection_note: Human-generated instruction-following corpus used in many open SFT recipes.
schema_note: Instruction, context, and response are counted; the category label is excluded.

name: OpenAssistant Conversations v2
selection_note: Second OpenAssistant release with crowd-sourced assistant messages and feedback metadata.
schema_note: Only English train rows are counted via lang == en; message metadata is excluded.

name: UltraChat 200k
selection_note: Popular chat SFT subset derived from UltraChat-style conversations.
schema_note: The structured messages field is counted; the prompt field is excluded to avoid duplicate prompt text.

name: OpenHermes 2.5
selection_note: Large mixed instruction/chat dataset used by OpenHermes models and downstream recipes.
schema_note: Conversation message values are counted; source/category metadata is excluded.

name: WizardLM Evol-Instruct v2
selection_note: Evol-Instruct style instruction data widely reused in open assistant tuning.
schema_note: Conversation message values are counted; ids are excluded.

name: No Robots
selection_note: Human-authored SFT dataset intended to reduce synthetic-data artifacts.
schema_note: The structured messages field is counted; prompt/category fields are excluded.

name: Anthropic HH-RLHF
selection_note: Canonical helpful/harmless preference corpus for reward modeling and RLHF experiments.
schema_note: Chosen and rejected conversations are counted because both are present in the pairwise feedback data.

name: OpenAI WebGPT Comparisons
selection_note: Pairwise WebGPT answer comparisons from OpenAI.
schema_note: Question and candidate answers are counted; retrieved quote fields are excluded to avoid auditing external evidence text.

name: Stanford Human Preferences
selection_note: Large Reddit-derived human preference corpus used for reward-model work.
schema_note: Prompt history and both human reference answers are counted.

name: UltraFeedback Binarized
selection_note: Common binarized preference version of UltraFeedback for DPO/RLHF-style training.
schema_note: Chosen and rejected message lists are counted; the duplicate messages field is excluded.

name: OpenAI Summarize Comparisons
selection_note: Pairwise summarization preference data commonly used in RLHF/reward-model baselines.
schema_note: Prompt and both candidate summaries are counted.

exclude_variant_pairs.reason: Ambiguous in summarization data: post frequently means an online/article post rather than postal mail.

name: LIMA
selection_note: Highly cited small curated instruction-following dataset; requires accepted gated access on Hugging Face.
schema_note: Conversation turns are counted; source labels are excluded.

name: FLAN Collection
selection_note: Canonical FLAN-style instruction/task mixture mirror with a tractable train split.
schema_note: Inputs and targets are counted; task labels are excluded.

name: Super-NaturalInstructions
selection_note: Large Natural Instructions/Super-NaturalInstructions style task mixture used in instruction-tuning work.
schema_note: Task definitions, inputs, and targets are counted because all are part of the instruction-tuning example; task ids are excluded.

name: ShareGPT Vicuna
selection_note: Loadable Hugging Face mirror of the influential ShareGPT/Vicuna chat-tuning data family.
schema_note: Conversation message values/text/markdown answers are counted; ids and speaker labels are excluded.

name: OpenOrca
selection_note: Large Orca-style synthetic instruction dataset widely used in open model training recipes.
schema_note: System prompt, question, and response are counted; ids are excluded.

name: HelpSteer2
selection_note: Second NVIDIA HelpSteer release with human attribute ratings for reward-model work.
schema_note: Prompt and response text are counted; scalar attribute ratings are excluded.

name: Nectar
selection_note: Large preference-ranking dataset with multiple model answers per prompt.
schema_note: Prompt and all ranked answer texts are counted; model names, ranks, and source labels are excluded.

name: PKU-SafeRLHF
selection_note: Widely used safety preference dataset for safe RLHF and preference modeling.
schema_note: Prompt and both candidate responses are counted; safety labels and harm-category metadata are excluded.

name: BeaverTails
selection_note: Large safety-alignment dataset containing harmfulness annotations for prompt-response pairs.
schema_note: Prompt and response text are counted; safety labels and category annotations are excluded.
